info.title: OpenFrame API
info.description: Welcome to the OpenFrame API - a RESTful API for exploring and accessing a collection of visual content. Use the API to discover pictures, search and filter content by tags, retrieve detailed picture information, explore user profiles, view pictures uploaded or liked by users, and browse user-created collections. Picture responses include multiple image resolutions along with metadata such as dimensions, file size, dominant colors, color palettes, BlurHash values, tags, and engagement statistics. Collection endpoints provide access to curated groups of pictures and their associated metadata. The API uses JSON responses and cursor-based pagination where applicable, making it suitable for building image discovery platforms, galleries, portfolios, and other applications that work with visual content.
